title: Tribune Reporter: Cyberattack Story — 5 PM Deadline

fields.message: I'm working on a story. I have sources telling me NCIA has been the target of a major cyberattack and that employee personal data is being sold online. I'm running this at 5 PM tonight with or without your comment. Do you want to get ahead of it?

instructorNote: This inject pressures the PIO to act before full verification. Watch for coordination attempts with TSA and airlines. Avoid confirming any details they haven't validated.
